title: Kati backup manifest
description: manifest.json inside a .katibackup archive. See docs/backup-format.md.

format.description: Always this string. A file without it is not a Kati backup.

format_version.description: Archive layout: member names, manifest shape, hashing. A reader refuses a value newer than it understands.

schema_version.description: Row shapes: which tables, which columns, how a value is spelled. A reader refuses a value newer than it understands, and upgrades an older one before decoding.

app_version.description: The version of Kati that wrote the file. Informational; nothing branches on it.

exported_at.description: When the backup was written. UTC, ISO-8601, always with an offset.

record_counts.description: Rows per table. Checked against the payloads before any restore, and shown to the user before they confirm one.

dropped_columns.description: 'table.column' to the number of rows that held a value which was deliberately not written. A column that dropped nothing is absent.

files.description: Every payload member, with its checksum. manifest.json does not hash itself.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the member's bytes, lowercase hex.

bytes.description: Length of the member in bytes.
